title: Numerical vs Categorical Association Analysis
description: Exploration of continuous variable distributions across discrete groups or cohorts.
conditions: One continuous dependent variable and one discrete grouping factor (e.g. Treatment arm, Region, Tier)
Need to determine if group means/medians differ significantly
Visual inspection of group variance homoscedasticity
recommended_methods: Grouped descriptive statistics (mean, median, std, IQR by category)
Comparative box plots and violin plots
Eta-squared (effect size) calculation from one-way ANOVA
selection_rules: If group distributions are Gaussian with equal variances (Levene's test p > 0.05), report ANOVA F and Eta-squared
If group distributions are skewed or sample sizes per group are small, report Kruskal-Wallis H statistic
If category has > 10 levels, sort groups by median value before plotting for interpretability
limitations: Unequal sample sizes across groups distort standard ANOVA F-tests (requires Welch ANOVA)
Violin plots can mislead if sample size within a group is < 20 observations
